history.note: live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend).

munchkin-wdr.description: Munchkin start by class: munchkin-d6 for Warriors, Druids and Rangers, default for every other class (the classes munchkin-d6 helped in classes-munchkin)

4.2.6-bbc-m10.label: better-borg-c milestone 10 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v10): carries stays 98, unchanged from milestone 9 - this cycle adds no new tracker carry. Its units are two owner-directed local improvements never proposed upstream (I-001: attack a lone adjacent monster one blow would kill; I-002: borg_caution() heals while fleeing at survivable danger) and a crash correction to the already-carried 0090-0099 patch 0099 (a stale borg.c position read out of bounds after a level change into a smaller level, matching borg-rs's reported SIGSEGV on first town return, borg-rs#21). Full matrix 234/234 cases, no failed group.

4.2.6-bbc-m9.label: better-borg-c milestone 9 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v9): 10 patch units since milestone 8 (patches 0090-0099: the 0090-0096 board batch and 0097-0099, including a memory-safety carry). Ported to borg-rs as 4.2.6-rs-m9.

smoke.description: better-borg-c frozen cohort v1: 3 seeds, 20,000 engine turns

experiment.description: Smoke check: is munchkin-wdr a no-op on M9 and M10, same as confirmed on M8? Both inherit the munchkin-by-class default from M8 without changing it, so the prior is strong - this is cheap confirmation before spending a full classes-1800 run on it.
experiment.name: m9-m10-munchkin-smoke
